Grid translations are extracted from Syncfusion's official `ej2-locale`
repository: https://github.com/syncfusion/ej2-locale/tree/master/src
Retrieved 2026-11-04. Only grid-related control dictionaries are retained.
English uses the built-in EJ2 English strings.

See `locale-license.txt` for the vendor's licensing notice.
The application references EJ2 JavaScript and Bootstrap 5.3 styling at
version 35.1.37 from Syncfusion's CDN. A matching Syncfusion license is required.

Scheduler/recurrence editor dictionaries are also included. Date formatting data
in `cldr/` comes from the official `@syncfusion/ej2-cldr-data` package, version
35.1.37. Each language JSON contains Gregorian dates, numbers, timezone names and
numbering systems. See `cldr/license.txt` for its bundled vendor license notice.
